facts.text: I am planning a trip to Colombia.
I am taking language exchange classes at a local school.
I am planning to stay in Medellín for a few weeks.
I will check out Mercado Minorista in Medellín.
I am trying to find a language exchange partner who is a native Spanish speaker.
I think I could find a language exchange partner through Juan, my tutor at the local language school.
Juan might know someone interested in practicing English.
I will ask Juan if he knows anyone interested in practicing English.
I have been enjoying my classes with Juan.
I feel like I am making progress with my Spanish.
Juan has been sharing insights about Colombian culture and customs with me.
Juan has been helping me understand the language better.
